title: Tripole Colonel Pro 105L Trekking Backpack — Metal Frame, Front Opening, Rain Cover
short_description: A large 105-litre trekking backpack with metal frame, front opening, detachable 15-litre daypack and integrated rain cover. For longer tours, trekking and travel.
long_description: The Tripole Colonel Pro is a large 105-litre trekking and travel backpack. A sturdy metal frame of twin rods plus an internal fibre frame provides high carrying comfort even with heavy loads. The front opening gives three access points (top, middle, bottom) for easier packing and quick access. A detachable 15-litre bag can be used separately as a daypack and holds a laptop. The water-repellent, PU-coated polyester and integrated rain cover keep gear dry. Ideal for longer treks, expeditions and travel.
features: Front opening with three access points
buying_angle: Practical for trekkers and travellers who want a very large, sturdy backpack with a metal frame and detachable daypack for long tours.
